chunks: Except an old woman who was one of those who stayed behind.

key_terms.الْغَابِرِينَ: Those who stayed behind / The persistent ones

ai.seo_question: Who is the old woman mentioned in Surah Al-Muddaththir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is often interpreted as referring to Umm Jamil, the wife of Abu Lahab, whose persistent hostility and role in spreading disinformation against the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) serve as a paradigm of entrenched opposition. This specific mention underscores the concept of *al-Ghabirin* (those left behind or remaining in the past), highlighting how key figures of the Quraysh remained spiritually stagnant despite the advent of revelation. The verse thus provides a historical anchor for understanding the social dynamics of early Mecca and the personal dimensions of prophetic struggle.
